office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets, covering school funding, tax structure, housing rules, health funding and criminal-justice statutes.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Democratic incumbent Mary Fosse is the only candidate for this seat.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Democratic State Representative and House Deputy Majority Floor Leader, a former Everett City Councilmember, running unopposed.
highlights: State Representative and Deputy Majority Floor Leader; previously on the Everett City Council [S1]
Lists lowering the cost of living, affordable housing, childcare and healthcare access as priorities [S1]
Endorsed by Sen. June Robinson, Sheriff Johnson, SnoCo Democrats, Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates and the Washington State Labor Council [S1]
